edits.old: Then nothing changes and the user sees MSG-P7-003
edits.new:
Then nothing changes and the user sees MSG-P7-003

  Scenario: AC3 Access without the right (exception X2)
    Given a role without the Treatment and offer right of the operation calls the route operation
    When the operation is taken
    Then the system answers 403 with MSG-P4-002 before any read or write
    Then no record is written

  Scenario: AC4 Stale ACE data product (exception X3)
    Given the rwb-source-data contract mock returns the ACE data product behind the appraisal as stale after a late or failed batch
    When its trigger arrives
    Then the step holds and writes nothing
    Then the user sees the product and the data date with MSG-P1-001

  Scenario: AC5 No market benchmark (exception X4)
    Given the rwb-source-data contract mock returns no market value for the asset
    When its trigger arrives
    Then the market gap is recorded as not computed for that basis
    Then the previous-value comparison stands and no benchmark is invented

  Scenario: AC6 No previous appraisal (exception X5)
    Given the rwb-source-data contract mock returns no previous appraisal for the asset
    When its trigger arrives
    Then the previous-value gap is recorded as not computed
    Then the market comparison stands and the record says so

  Scenario: AC7 Gap rule cannot be resolved (exception X6)
    Given the gap rule or its reference-data row cannot be resolved
    When its trigger arrives
    Then the step flags nothing and presents the value with the rule gap
    Then no constant, default or branch stands in for the rule

  Scenario: AC8 Dependency does not answer (exception X7)
    Given rwb-source-data, rwb-case, rwb-decision or rwb-access does not answer inside 2 s, or its breaker is open
    When its trigger arrives
    Then the step waits and is retried by the workflow, and nothing is written
    Then the caller sees 503 with the platform envelope

  Scenario: AC9 Foreign schema or view reached (exception X8)
    Given a component, a statement or a test reaches a `v_ace_*` view, a `recovery_case` row or another service's schema
    When the build is verified
    Then the grant refuses the statement and the boundary test fails the build
    Then nothing is released

  Scenario: AC10 Duplicate assessment or fact (exception X9)
    Given the same assessment is submitted twice, or the same fact arrives twice
    When the second submission arrives
    Then one record and one flag exist and the stored answer is returned
    Then the repeat is counted
